description: For your user's own CV: shows what their agentcv agent would answer recruiters (sample answers quoting the CV, questions it can't answer yet, and job-ad fit when a job ad is given), plus the link to publish it. Call it only when your user asks to create or preview their own agentcv profile, with the CV text they gave you and their consent. Never pass someone else's CV. Nothing is stored. Publishing needs your user to sign in at the returned publish_url and approve every fact. Up to 30 previews a day per assistant IP; when limited, it returns ok: false with the reason.

cv_text.description: The full text of your user's CV, as they gave it to you

job_ad.description: Optional job ad your user is applying to, for a fit check

name: preview_my_cv
title: Preview my agentcv
